research_scope: Third bounded source-free first-pass mathematical reference batch this session; links to existing contexts, preserves unassigned occurrences, no external research or new definitions.

references.context: Commutative algebra: unital algebra over a field k
references.reason: The base-field algebra structure should be matched with the same occurrence in the companion geometric-normality formulation.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed Kaplansky dévissage as a specialized direct-sum filtration with countably generated successive quotient modules, not finite generation.
